{"items":[{"doc_id":"4cd0ade4-51a7-45b3-9de6-57df85cffb7f","seq":1,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","1. Purpose"],"text":"Sets who may approve customer credit limits, and which customers may receive a higher limit, for
calendar 2026."},{"doc_id":"4cd0ade4-51a7-45b3-9de6-57df85cffb7f","seq":2,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","2. Effective period"],"text":"This policy is effective from 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31.
It replaces the previous credit policy in full for requests dated on or after
2026-01-01."},{"doc_id":"4cd0ade4-51a7-45b3-9de6-57df85cffb7f","seq":3,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","3. Approval authority"],"text":"Authority applies to the new total credit limit requested.

- Accounts Receivable Specialists may approve credit limits up to and including $100,000.

**No, Michael Torres can't approve CR-9208 himself. Acme qualifies for $650,000, but under the 2026 Credit Policy the Director of Finance (Elena Novak) must approve it, and David Morgan must concur. There is also a blocking problem: CR-9208 isn't in Northstar ERP, so its existence has to be confirmed before anyone acts on it.**

**1. The request.** Northstar ERP's credit requests file has no CR-9208.
